Rae (Docs): FYI I opened a PR to add an "Optimize toolkit" quick-reference focused on batching/caching/quant. It includes tiny Python + Go SDK snippets, a decision flow, and a quant-profile rename table. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 (WIP)
Diego H.: nice. can we include both per-route and global examples? platform teams will copy the per-route one usually.
Rae (Docs): yep — added per-route Node earlier, now adding Python and Go per-route examples. keeping global example in a separate block labeled "cluster/global defaults".
Priya N.: heads-up: linkcheck CI found two broken links to old model names (open-llama-13b -> open-llama-13b-v2) and a stale SDK package page.
deploy-bot: ci/docs-linkcheck failed on PR #912: 2 broken links (docs/optkit/heuristics.md: lines 42, 78). Logs: https://ci.redwood/912/linkcheck
Rae (Docs): thanks Priya — I'll update the references. also replacing any @redwood/sdk mentions with @redwood/inference-py and @redwood/inference-go.
Diego H.: quick style note — docs reviewers like minimal config that "just works". For Python snippet, prefer a context manager example that shows batching enabled by route config.
Rae (Docs): adding that. draft Python snippet:
```
# Python SDK: per-route batching + kv prefetch
from redwood.inference import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))

client.create_route('answers', config={
  'model': 'open-llama-13b-v2',
  'batching': {'max_tokens_per_batch': 1500, 'max_batch_size': 6, 'timeout_ms': 12},
  'kv_prefetch': {'enabled': True, 'ttl_seconds': 180}
})
```
Priya N.: small nit: match timeout_ms to runtime default 10ms. Also add a one-line caveat: "Avoid batching >1 for multi-turn stateful dialogs where latency per turn is critical."
Rae (Docs): updated timeout to 10 and added the caveat.
bench-bot: attached benchmark summary for q4_0 vs q8_0 at batch-size 6 (synth workload): q4_0 median latency 42ms, q8_0 median latency 58ms, token-cost delta ~ -32% for q4_0. See gist: https://bench.redwood/q4-vs-q8-batch6
Diego H.: awesome — can we insert those numbers into the migration note? teams appreciate a concrete tradeoff.
Rae (Docs): yes; I'll add a tiny table and link to bench gist. Also renaming legacy profiles: old names "small-legacy" -> "q4_0-compat"; "large-legacy" -> "q8_0-default". adding mapping YAML in the PR.
Priya N.: also add a short entry: "If evals show unacceptable quality drop on q4_0, switch to q8_0 and consider enabling kv_prefetch to recover latency."
Rae (Docs): done. one more CI failure popped up: code-samples linter flagged Go import path.
deploy-bot: ci/code-samples lint failed: examples/go/snippet.go imports github.com/redwood/sdk instead of github.com/redwood/inference-go.
Rae (Docs): fixed import and small formatting issues; pushed commit.
Diego H.: LGTM from me after the wording tweaks. Priya, can you do a final pass on accuracy phrasing and anchors?
Priya N.: I'll check and then approve. please add anchor id #optkit-quickref so release notes can link directly.
Rae (Docs): added anchor and a one-line changelog blurb under "Unreleased". tagging for merge once CI passes. Thanks! :sparkles:
